style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontColor=#8c8f98;fontSize=11;fontFamily=IBM Plex Sans;spacing=0;" value="Dispatch publishes each accepted event to wft.intake, which routes it by its routing key to the quorum queue of its tenant and priority class. Admission receives a message only for credit it grants and settles each one: a counted retry comes back after a delay and dead-letters after the fifth, a release counts nothing and returns to the head of the queue, and a held delivery lost with its connection counts as failed. Every dead letter lands in one queue with a reason that says how to recover it, and stays there until an operator replays or purges it." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="910" x="20" y="610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Dispatch publishes each accepted event to wft.intake, which routes it by its routing key to the quorum queue of its tenant and priority class. Admission receives a message only for credit it grants and settles each one: a counted retry comes back after a delay and dead-letters after the fifth, a release counts nothing and returns to the head of the queue, and a held delivery lost with its connection counts as failed. Every dead letter lands in one queue with a reason that says how to recover it, and stays there until an operator replays or purges it.
